source.author: William Lilly
source.title: Christian Astrology
source.chapter: CVII: Of the Manners of the Native or Child
source.verification: Source text checked against rendered scans on 2026-11-22; first-branch words on page 535, fallbacks on page 536; later fixed-star rules continue beyond page 536.

rules.source_condition: Any planet occupies the sign ascending OR an intercepted sign
rules.mechanical_part: Membership of the seven traditional planets in the zodiacal sign of the Ascendant
rules.missing: Intercepted signs, how to use house vs sign rising, source-specific strength/fortification for multiple candidates

rules.source_condition: Multiple rising-sign candidates signify varieties of manners, with the strongest most persistent
rules.missing: Complete original strength/dignity/sect evaluation and length of persistence

rules.source_condition: Mercury assumes planetary nature by conjunction to nearest and strongest; otherwise essential-dignity dispositorship
rules.missing: Historically faithful conjunction scope and priority/strength adjudication

rules.source_condition: Luminaries in the horoscope matter conditionally if strongly fortified
rules.missing: Strong fortification rule and differentiation of luminaries versus other planets

rules.source_condition: When no planet is in the Ascendant, choose planet joined to Moon or Mercury; later select Ascendant lord if required, then partile aspect, finally most dignified at Moon/Mercury places
rules.missing: Priority ambiguities, exact application/aspect, lord-dispositor seeing conditions, essential-dignity calculation

rules.source_condition: Manners significator conjunct a first/second-magnitude fixed star carries additional indications
rules.missing: historical star catalog, precession, ecliptic latitude and source orb

rules.source_condition: Fortune, planetary condition and mixtures modify manners
rules.missing: Whole chart source condition, opposing testimony, dependency grouping

scientific_inference: Can count mechanical candidate-presence frequency only; cannot determine actual manners significator, behavioral fit, global best natal chart, or human prediction.
